description: Start a conversation with a candidate by talent slug. Optionally send an initial message. If the conversation already exists, returns it. Use search_talent to find candidates first, then use their slug here. Uses the connected Himalayas employer account; no extra sign-in needed.

message.description: Optional initial message to send with the conversation

talent_slug.description: Talent slug of the candidate to message (from search_talent results)

name: start_conversation
